decode_mask_dict: decode a mask dictionary with width, height, and encodedMask keys into a numpy array
decode_mask_object: decode a Mask dataclass object into a numpy array using LZ-string decompression and RLE decoding
blend_mask_on_image: blend a binary mask over an input image with a configurable alpha transparency value
create_mask_dataclass: create a Mask dataclass instance with width, height, and encoded_mask string fields
summarize_mask_utils: summarize the masks module functions for decoding compressed masks and blending them on images
